usage: 垃圾袋 (laap6 saap3 doi2) is a noun used to refer to a bag for collecting trash.
You can use 垃圾袋 when talking about taking out the trash or cleaning the house.
Adjectives related to size or strength often come before 垃圾袋, like 大嘅垃圾袋 (big trash bag).
You can also use measure words with 垃圾袋, for example 一個垃圾袋 (one trash bag).
The word 垃圾袋 is commonly used in everyday conversations about waste management.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3 hau5 ge3 laap6 saap3 doi2.
examples.meaning: We bought several thick trash bags.
